# XeroIP engineering standards

> Shared standards for documentation, prose, code, design, and diagrams across
> every XeroIP repository. Markdown throughout, so the source is the same text a
> model reads. Each area's README is the entry point; the pages under it are the
> rules and name what enforces them.

This file is generated from front matter by tools/build-llms-txt.js.

## Documentation

- [Documentation standard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/documentation/README.md): How documentation is structured, named, written, and enforced across every repo.
- [Architecture decision records](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/documentation/adr.md): MADR-format decision records, superseding the ad-hoc decision documents already in use.
- [Documentation consistency tests](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/documentation/consistency.md): Tests that fail when a documented value stops matching the code it describes, generalised from a Flutter project where it already works.
- [Front matter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/documentation/front-matter.md): The required YAML schema on every page, and the opt-in that scopes severity colour.
- [Post-incident reviews](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/documentation/incident-reviews.md): One required structure for incident reviews, replacing three divergent templates and the hand-written HTML they were rendered in.
- [File naming and links](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/documentation/naming.md): Filenames, why ordinal prefixes are banned, and how links and redirects are kept honest.
- [Page anatomy](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/documentation/page-anatomy.md): Headings, tables, code blocks, the four admonitions, and accessibility requirements.
- [Documentation structure](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/documentation/structure.md): Diátaxis plus ADRs, incidents, an ops log, and project records, and which gates each repo profile runs.

## Prose

- [Prose standard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/prose/README.md): House writing style, derived from multi-vendor research and enforced by generated Vale rules.
- [Master language rule](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/prose/master-language-rule.md): The full rule pack with tiers, evidence, and provenance.
- [Validation checklist](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/prose/validation-checklist.md): The per-draft review pass, tiered critical / important / optional.

## Coding

- [Coding standard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/coding/README.md): Global engineering rules plus per-stack tooling, harvested from the Copilot instructions where they already worked.
- [Bash](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/coding/bash.md): Strict mode, shellcheck, and where a shell script stops being the right tool.
- [Dart and Flutter](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/coding/dart-flutter.md): Formatting, analysis, SDK pinning, and the release-agreement rule from rolling-text.
- [Docker and Compose](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/coding/docker.md): hadolint, image pinning, and keeping secrets out of images and compose files.
- [Global engineering rules](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/coding/global.md): Priorities, change discipline, git conventions, and safety rules that apply in every repo regardless of language.
- [JavaScript and TypeScript](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/coding/javascript-typescript.md): ESLint and Prettier, the tsconfig baseline, and dependency discipline.
- [Kotlin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/coding/kotlin.md): ktlint, Compose naming, and the architecture conventions already in use.
- [PowerShell](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/coding/powershell.md): Approved verbs, splatting, strict error handling, and dry-run modes for destructive scripts.
- [Python](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/coding/python.md): ruff and black, typing expectations, and packaging layout.
- [YAML and GitHub Actions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/coding/yaml-actions.md): yamllint, actionlint, and the SHA-pinning policy promoted from rolling-text.

## Design

- [Console Editorial](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/design/README.md): The design system — editorial structure and typography carrying an operations-console palette, dark canonical.

## Diagrams

- [Diagram generation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/diagrams/README.md): Which tool draws which diagram, and how to check the result before trusting it.
- [Diagram QA tools](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/diagrams/tools/README.md): Two dependency-free checkers for defects that eyeballing a rendered SVG reliably misses.

## Observability

- [Observability standard](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/observability/README.md) *(draft)*: Not yet written. This page states the scope and the questions it has to answer.

## Decision records

- [Decision records](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/adr/README.md): The decisions this repository has made about itself, in MADR format.
- [MkDocs + Material as the documentation toolchain](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/adr/0001-mkdocs-material-as-the-documentation-toolchain.md)

## Project records

- [Documentation toolchain bake-off](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/projects/2026-09-06-documentation-toolchain-bake-off.md): Seven documentation generators built the same three pages; the measured result behind ADR-0001.
- [Documentation generator survey](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/projects/2026-09-10-documentation-generator-survey.md): The twenty-generator screen that should have preceded the bake-off, and the thirteen rejections.

## Optional

- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/AGENTS.md): instructions for agents working in the standards repo itself.
- [rules.yml](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/prose/rules.yml): the prose markers in machine-readable form, with tier and marker id.
- [tokens.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/XeroIP/standards/main/docs/design/tokens.json): design tokens, the source every adapter is generated from.
